These 10 call ids do not appear in the human-label file, so agent-vs-human agreement cannot be computed for them.

root_causes.title: Local ASR cannot read these telephony clips
root_causes.why: The recordings are 8 kHz mono telephony Hindi. The local whisper model garbles or loops on them, so the matrix cannot be applied. This is an ASR problem, not a bot problem.

blockers.title: ASR fidelity
blockers.detail: Local whisper 'base' on 8 kHz Hindi telephony: several transcripts are garbled or repeating; only the English call is clean. A Hindi ASR (e.g. Sarvam Saarika/Saaras) is needed.
